title: Supportive Token Revealing for Fast Diffusion Language Model Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2606.04236v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models can generate text efficiently by updating multiple masked positions in parallel, but this parallelism introduces a quality-latency trade-off. Aggressive decoding may commit mutually dependent tokens too early, while conservative decoding requires many denoising steps. Existing methods address this tension by deciding which tokens are safe to reveal using confidence or dependency criteria. However, avoiding unsafe commits does not necessarily make the remaining masked sequence easy to decode, since uncertain tokens may depend on masked tokens, creating a bottleneck for denoising steps. We propose AXON, a training-free module that can be added on top of existing parallel decoding strategies for diffusion language models. Rather than replacing the base decoder, AXON monitors the remaining uncertain masked tokens and intervenes only when their current state suggests that additional context is need

translated_title: 支持性令牌揭示：加速扩散语言模型解码
translated_abstract: 离散扩散语言模型可以通过并行更新多个被掩码的位置来高效生成文本，但这种并行性引入了质量与延迟之间的权衡。激进的解码可能过早地确定相互依赖的令牌，而保守的解码则需要许多去噪步骤。现有方法通过基于置信度或依赖性准则判断哪些令牌可以安全揭示来缓解这一矛盾。然而，避免不安全的提交并不一定能使剩余的掩码序列易于解码，因为不确定的令牌可能依赖于其他被掩码的令牌，这成为去噪步骤的瓶颈。我们提出了AXON，这是一个无需训练的模块，可以叠加在现有的扩散语言模型并行解码策略之上。AXON并不替换基础解码器，而是监控剩余的不确定掩码令牌，仅在其当前状态表明需要额外上下文时才进行干预。
tldr: 提出无需训练的AXON模块，通过监控剩余的不确定掩码令牌并在需要额外上下文时揭示支持性令牌，从而加速扩散语言模型的并行解码并缓解质量与延迟之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: AXON is a training-free plug-in module that accelerates parallel decoding of diffusion language models by monitoring uncertain masked tokens and revealing supportive tokens to provide additional context only when needed, easing the quality-latency trade-off.
